traps: the library has no source file to compile: an INTERFACE target carries only headers, include paths and the C++20 requirement
include/ringbuf/config.h is C++ (namespace, inline constexpr) with a .h extension; a reader that maps .h to C gets it wrong
C++20 is required through target_compile_features(cxx_std_20), not CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD: it propagates to every consumer
ringbuf_tests links the alias ringbuf::ringbuf; the alias is the same unit as ringbuf, not a second one
the tests exist only when ringbuf is the top-level project; consumed through add_subdirectory or FetchContent they are skipped
the header's include path is <ringbuf/ringbuf.hpp>, relative to include/, not to the header's own directory
